title: Distill the homepage hero
question: Primary job is one: get a North Shore parent to book the free trial. What’s the right cut?

options.label: One story, one action
options.thesis: Keep headline + short sub + image + CTA. Drop the checklist and social from the first viewport.
options.case: Checklist restates the sub; social is student-channel noise next to the only conversion action.
options.risk: Parents lose the three proof bullets until they scroll into team/about.
options.viewport: Title · one supporting sentence · image · Book free trial

options.label: Keep proof, lose social
options.thesis: Trim the checklist to two non-overlapping points; move or remove social; put CTA next to the copy.
options.case: Parents still get the HSC-tutor + flexibility claims without competing icons.
options.risk: Still denser than a true distill; first viewport stays busy.
options.viewport: Title · short sub · two ticks · CTA · image

options.label: Visual quiet only
options.thesis: Keep all copy blocks; only strip decorative noise (dead TikTok, extra footer wrapper, soften competing styles).
options.case: Safest if you want the persuasion stack intact.
options.risk: Doesn’t fix cognitive load — still three messages before the action.
